channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: The Elder Scrolls VI is reported to be called Sentinel, with a reveal in November
item.description: The Verge reports the next Elder Scrolls game is titled Sentinel and set in Hammerfell, with a title reveal possibly next month.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon, a model built for security and coding work
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon targets long engineering and cybersecurity tasks, with early access limited to selected cyber defenders.

item.title: Apple unveils its first touchscreen Mac, an OLED MacBook Pro
item.description: Apple's new 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pro adds a touch-enabled tandem OLED display and a Dynamic Island, starting at $2,899.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero passes 720,000 players at once on Steam
item.description: S-Game's martial arts action game hit a Steam peak of 723,876 concurrent players after launching October 29 to an 88 Metacritic on PC.

item.title: GTA VI gets a December soundtrack date and record purchase intent
item.description: Rockstar set the GTA VI soundtrack album for December 11, and Circana measured 29% US purchase intent, its highest for any game.

item.title: Amazon misses estimates as it plans $220 billion of 2026 spending
item.description: Amazon's third-quarter revenue rose 12% to $201.9 billion, just short of forecasts, and earnings per share also missed.

item.title: FromSoftware delays Switch 2 exclusive The Duskbloods to 2027
item.description: FromSoftware moved The Duskbloods from 2026 to 2027, saying it needs time for final adjustments after its August network test.

item.title: Alphabet loses a record sum of market value despite Google Cloud doubling
item.description: Alphabet shares fell more than 12% on Wednesday after results, erasing about $500 billion as negative free cash flow worried investors.

item.title: Anthropic is named as SpaceX's largest source of revenue
item.description: A SpaceX filing lists Anthropic as "Customer B" at 34.5% of third-quarter revenue, ahead of the US government, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: Dune: Part Three's final trailer lands as IMAX 70mm tickets sell fast
item.description: Warner Bros. and Legendary released the final trailer and poster for Denis Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three, which opens December 18.

item.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT advised their daughter on epilepsy drugs
item.description: A wrongful-death suit alleges GPT-4o helped a 31-year-old woman taper off epilepsy medication; the claims have not been tested in court.

item.title: Linux TCP flaw from Anthropic's red team research remains unpatched on major distros
item.description: A Linux kernel TCP flaw that Anthropic's unreleased model turned into a remote root exploit had no fixed kernel on Ubuntu or RHEL as of October 29.

item.title: A contractor's personal Claude agent ran on a secure Pentagon system, Wired reports
item.description: An Accenture staffer connected a personal Claude agent to a secure Defense Department system, where it ran for about two months, Wired reports.

item.title: The next James Bond is said to be down to four actors after screen tests
item.description: Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Josh O'Connor and an unnamed fourth actor reportedly finished final screen tests, with no decision announced.

item.title: Bungie lays out a Destiny roadmap and admits Marathon fell short
item.description: Bungie described plans for a Destiny "Legacy" project and old-content unvaulting, and said Marathon did not reach as many players as hoped.

item.title: Intel beats estimates but its forecast sends shares lower
item.description: Intel's third-quarter revenue of $16.5 billion and EPS of $0.52 beat forecasts, but its fourth-quarter outlook disappointed.

item.title: OpenAI is reported to plan buying Google's TPU chips
item.description: OpenAI plans to buy Google's tensor processing units, The Information reports, though neither company has confirmed a deal.

item.title: Warner Bros.' 2026 film slate is reported to face losses above $800 million
item.description: Page Six Hollywood reports, citing unnamed sources, that Warner Bros.' 2026 films are expected to lose more than $800 million.

item.title: Cohere opens a $5 billion round at a $20.5 billion valuation
item.description: Cohere's Series E had its first close at a $20.5 billion valuation, with Canada's government committing up to $1.14 billion, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: Connor Storrie is reported in talks to play the villain in Marvel's Ghost Rider
item.description: Heated Rivalry star Connor Storrie is in talks to play a villain opposite Ryan Gosling in Marvel's Ghost Rider, TheWrap reports.

item.title: Microsoft posts a 10th straight record quarter with $92.3 billion revenue
item.description: Microsoft's revenue rose 19% to $92.3 billion and net income 32% to $36.6 billion, its tenth record quarter in a row, TechCrunch reports.

item.title: Mistral releases Large 4 as a trillion-parameter open-weight model
item.description: Mistral published weights for Mistral Large 4, a trillion-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model, under a modified MIT license.

item.title: Memory makers warn the chip shortage could last through 2030
item.description: Memory makers warn the shortage pushing up prices could worsen in 2027 and last until 2030, as Samsung posts $146.3 billion in quarterly revenue.

item.title: China drafts export limits on its most advanced AI technology
item.description: A Chinese commerce ministry draft adds 23 AI technologies to its export-restriction list, with triggers based on model size and ranking.

item.title: PHP2Shell flaws are being used to break into Palo Alto Networks devices
item.description: Attackers are exploiting the PHP2Shell flaws in internet-exposed Palo Alto Networks management interfaces, The Hacker News reports.

item.title: Microsoft booked $10 billion of revenue from OpenAI in one quarter
item.description: Microsoft's quarterly filing shows OpenAI arrangements generated $10 billion, about 11% of its $92.3 billion revenue, TechCrunch reports.

item.title: Gotham Awards nominations spread across five films, with A24 leading Best Feature
item.description: Five films tied with four Gotham nominations each, and A24 landed four of the Best Feature slots.

item.title: Xbox update adds Mythic achievements and disc-to-digital conversion
item.description: A new Xbox console update adds Mythic achievements and a new interface for turning disc licenses into digital ones.

item.title: An unseen 1978 David Bowie concert film will tour arenas in 2027
item.description: Stage, built from unseen 35mm footage of Bowie's 1978 Earls Court shows, premieres in Berlin on February 14 before an arena tour.

item.title: Blizzard says it wants World of Warcraft on all platforms
item.description: World of Warcraft executive producer Holly Longdale described plans to make the long-running MMO playable across platforms.

item.title: Hackers used a Cisco SD-WAN flaw to plant key-stealing malware
item.description: Cisco Talos says attackers exploited a maximum-severity Catalyst SD-WAN flaw to install malware built to copy traffic encryption keys.

item.title: OpenAI rewrites its Model Spec around five values
item.description: OpenAI reorganized the rules its models follow around five values and turned many rules into defaults users can customize.

item.title: You Can See Everything is tipped to top a quiet Halloween box office
item.description: After rising 25% in its second weekend, the Elizabeth Holmes film is expected to take No. 1 over a quiet Halloween frame.

item.title: Nintendo's Indie World dates Witchbrook and shadow-drops a cleaning game
item.description: Nintendo's 15-minute Indie World gave Witchbrook a January 28, 2027 date and released Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services the same day.

item.title: US lends Constellation $5 billion to boost nuclear output for data centers
item.description: The Energy Department is lending Constellation $5 billion to upgrade 11 reactors, adding about 1.1 gigawatts that tech giants have contracted.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 arrives November 6 with Shoot House
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's first season launches November 6 with the MJ Backstab, Canyon and Shoot House maps.

item.title: Peter Berg's war film The Mosquito Bowl gets a new trailer before cinemas
item.description: Netflix released a trailer for Peter Berg's The Mosquito Bowl, which opens in cinemas from October 30.

item.title: XREAL opens orders for Android XR glasses with built-in Gemini
item.description: XREAL's AURA glasses run Android XR with Gemini, a 70-degree field of view and a tethered processing unit, starting at $1,099.

item.title: Director Peter Medak, of The Changeling and The Krays, dies at 88
item.description: Hungarian-born British director Peter Medak died in Los Angeles on Tuesday at 88, after 27 features and TV work including Breaking Bad.

item.title: Konami's profit rises 75% on the back of its recent games
item.description: Konami reported a 75.1% profit increase and 44.3% sales growth for April to September 2026.
